name: NAHN Enhanced Pipeline v2.2 - Full Multi-Agent Architecture

nodes.name: Daily Trigger (6 AM)
nodes.notes: Runs daily at 6 AM to check for new publications and clinical trials

nodes.name: Manual Trigger
nodes.notes: For testing and ad-hoc signal processing

nodes.name: NAHN Health Check
nodes.notes: Verifies NAHN FastAPI server is running before processing

parameters.name: term
parameters.value: (neurosurgery[MeSH] OR "brain surgery" OR "spine surgery" OR "craniotomy" OR "laminectomy" OR "shunt" OR "deep brain stimulation" OR "aneurysm clipping" OR "glioma resection" OR "meningioma" OR "hydrocephalus") AND (randomized controlled trial[pt] OR meta-analysis[pt] OR systematic review[pt] OR "propensity score") AND ("last 7 days"[dp])

nodes.name: PubMed Search
nodes.notes: Searches PubMed for recent neurosurgical RCTs, meta-analyses, and systematic reviews

parameters.name: query.cond
parameters.value: neurosurgery OR brain tumor OR glioblastoma OR spinal stenosis OR hydrocephalus OR intracranial aneurysm OR deep brain stimulation OR Parkinson surgery

nodes.name: ClinicalTrials.gov Search
nodes.notes: Searches for completed neurosurgical trials with results posted

nodes.name: Merge & Normalize Sources
nodes.notes: Combines PubMed and ClinicalTrials.gov results into unified format with subspecialty detection

nodes.name: Fetch PubMed Abstracts
nodes.notes: Fetches full abstracts for top 25 PubMed results

nodes.name: Parse & Score Abstracts
nodes.notes: Parses PubMed XML and calculates multi-factor relevance scores

nodes.name: Prepare NAHN Signals
nodes.notes: Prepares high-relevance signals for NAHN API evaluation

nodes.name: Process Each Signal
nodes.notes: Processes each signal individually through the NAHN pipeline

nodes.name: NAHN API Evaluate
nodes.notes: Sends signal to NAHN FastAPI for full evaluation including method recommendation, journal targeting, and subgroup detection

nodes.name: Deep Research Agent
nodes.notes: Calls multi-agent deep research (MiniMax M2.1 -> OpenAI -> Gemini fallback chain)

nodes.name: Backward Snowballing
nodes.notes: Performs backward snowballing using Semantic Scholar API to expand literature search

nodes.name: Exa Semantic Search
nodes.notes: Uses Exa API for neural semantic search to find related studies and methodology insights

nodes.name: Merge Research Results
nodes.notes: Combines results from Deep Research, Snowballing, and Exa Search into unified enhanced signal

nodes.name: Format Enhanced Notification
nodes.notes: Formats comprehensive notification with all research layers for email and Slack

nodes.name: Build Notifications
nodes.notes: Prepares final notification payloads for email and Slack

nodes.name: Send Email
nodes.notes: Sends comprehensive email notification with all research findings

nodes.name: Send Slack
nodes.notes: Sends Slack notification with research summary

nodes.name: Store Enhanced Signal
nodes.notes: Stores enhanced signal with all research layers for audit trail and future reference

nodes.name: Generate Enhanced PROSPERO
nodes.notes: Generates enhanced PROSPERO template with deep research findings and snowball references

nodes.name: Log API Failure
nodes.notes: Logs API failures for debugging

nodes.name: No Results
nodes.notes: Handles case when no new signals are found

nodes.name: Low Relevance
nodes.notes: Handles case when no high-relevance signals are found

nodes.name: Daily Summary
nodes.notes: Aggregates daily processing summary with enhancement layer statistics

nodes.name: Test Signal (iNPH)
nodes.notes: Test signal for hydrocephalus subspecialty

nodes.name: Test Signal (Spine)
nodes.notes: Test signal for spine subspecialty

nodes.name: MiniMax Multi-Agent Research
nodes.notes: Calls MiniMax M2.1 with interleaved thinking for deep research synthesis. Falls back to OpenAI/Gemini if unavailable.
